incident-bot: Pager triggered: router-weighting-service p99 latency breach in us-west-2 (auto-escalation). AlertID: RBW-2026-03-15-77 :rotating_light:

Ava (oncall): seeing it on Dashboards — p95 jumped to ~2.1s and p99 to ~7s for router-proxy in us-west-2, streaming sessions showing stalls and reconnects. Customers reporting video generation timeouts. Paging Priya and Samir.

Priya (sre): +1, I'm tailing the router metrics now. Streaming stall rate up 0.9% -> 4.5%. Is there a deployment around 15:58 UTC?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: deploy/weighting-config v2026-03-15-8 promoted to canary at 15:57 UTC by samir, rollout started to us-west-2.

Samir (eng-runtime): I rolled a new routing policy variant "sessionAffinityV2" to improve locality. Rolling back now as a quick mitigation. Patch note: changed seed for consistent-hash and introduced per-tenant weight overrides.

Ava (oncall): rollback in flight, status?

Samir (eng-runtime): rollback triggered: command -> `rbctl rollout undo weighting-config v2026-03-15-8 --region usw2 --force`

Priya (sre): Observability: comparing pre/post, looks like a hot partition focused on shard 14. Hash distribution shifted; shard 14 QPS jumped x6. Logs show increased queueing on router-proxy-14. Snippet:

```
router-proxy-14 | queue_ms p95: 210 -> 1200
router-proxy-14 | active_streams: 320 -> 1980
router-proxy-14 | stream_close_rate: 0.2% -> 3.8%
```
Ava (oncall): customer impact? Raj, any reports from big customers?

Raj (customer-ops): We got two SEV tickets from VideoCorp and Chatly — both in us-west-2, intermittent streaming stalls and increased error retries. VideoCorp is on Dedicated capacity but using routed sessions through shared ingress for now. They're being paged.

Priya (sre): Rollback completed at 16:03 UTC. Early telemetry: p95 down to ~320ms, p99 trending down to ~1.6s but still noisy. We're seeing leftover connections stuck on proxies; evicting long-lived sessions on proxy-14 to clear backlog.

Samir (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: the new policy used an incorrect modulus when computing bucket assignments for the consistent hash seed; combined with per-tenant overrides this allowed a few tenant keys to concentrate on a single shard (hotspot). Also a subtle bug in the sharding fallback logic made region-skew worse when weights were non-uniform. I'm opening a PR to add unit tests and a canary check that validates shard QPS divergence before full rollout.

Ava (oncall): Mitigations live: rollback done, manual traffic-split applied to divert 30% of requests away from shard-14, evictions scheduled, and longer-lived streams forced to reconnect. Any remaining errors in logs?

Priya (sre): Still seeing some streaming stalls for a small subset of requests — likely clients with sticky sessions that didn't reconnect. We'll force drain on the instance and trigger a graceful reconnect. Running: `rbctl proxy drain proxy-14 --grace 30s`

Samir (eng-runtime): Confirmed fix candidate merged to staging with stricter hash math and pre-rollout checks. Also added telemetry alert for shard QPS skew ratio > 3x.

Ava (oncall): Customer comms: Raj to notify VideoCorp point-of-contact with status + ETA. Priya to post short incident update on status page. Samir to follow up with code patch and postmortem.

Raj (customer-ops): Notified VideoCorp and Chatly with timeline and current mitigations. Both teams requested contact for RCA once complete.

Priya (sre): Post-action: p95 now stable at 280-350ms, p99 1.1-1.9s. Streaming stall rate down to 0.6%. Marking on-call handoff in 25m — leaving a runbook note in #eng-sre.

Ava (oncall): Thanks everyone. Action items:
- Samir: PR + unit tests + canary check (owner)
- Priya: post incident update and runbook entry (owner)
- Raj: customer followups and RCA comms (owner)
- Ava: schedule postmortem in 48h and assign authors

incident-bot: Incident RBW-2026-03-15-77 acknowledged, severity: Sev3, start: 15:57 UTC, end-triage: 16:12 UTC, owners assigned.

Samir (eng-runtime): quick note for postmortem: include analysis of per-tenant overrides, weight normalization logic, and a small simulation script I used to reproduce the concentration locally. I'll attach traces and the failing test cases.

Priya (sre): adding logs and query samples to the incident ticket now. Closing live mitigation loop, moving to RCA phase.

Ava (oncall): Closing thread — will reopen if we see regression. :white_check_mark:
